author: Vitor
aiExplanation: This solution uses a **Trie data structure** combined with **dynamic programming** to find the minimum cost to transform a `source` string into a `target` string using allowed character transformations. It first builds a Trie to store all the original-to-changed character pairs and assigns each unique pair an ID, then applies the **Floyd-Warshall algorithm** to the cost matrix to find the cheapest paths between any two characters through intermediate transformations. Finally, it uses a DP array where `resDp[j]` represents the minimum cost to transform the first `j+1` characters of the source string, iterating through each position and trying all possible substring transformations that exist in the Trie.
